C0610.title: Nong'an Court Finds JD Cash-Out On-Lending IOU Invalid
C0610.summary: In January 2026, Nong'an County People's Court in Jilin reported a private lending dispute. From October 2022 to July 2023, Guo repeatedly lent money to Li, and part of the funds came from JD cash-out. The court held that this constituted on-lending of funds obtained from a financial institution, making the IOU invalid under mandatory legal rules. The interest claim was not supported, but Li still had to return the 210,000 yuan principal.
